GhostSingleton Class

A C++ class with QML_SINGLETON but no \qmltype documentation. More...

Header: #include <GhostSingleton>

Detailed Description

This class should NOT generate any QML documentation pages or index entries. It exists purely to test that QML_SINGLETON detection doesn't create "ghost" QML documentation when only C++ documentation is present.
